name: Hongbee Park
title: Product Leader & Design Engineer
bio: Hongbee Park is a product leader and design engineer with over eight years of experience across startups, government, and industry. She has led national digital transformation initiatives, built AI-driven health-tech solutions, and driven product strategy across software and hardware. Her past work spans everything from public service innovation to smart devices and wearables.
